name: Gearbox
text: Choose **Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct** as EXCAVA’s new core LLM. It’s free, open-weight, and benchmarks show it beats other 70B-class models on reasoning tasks—even Mythos 5 in some cases—without hidden costs. The trade-off is raw speed: it’s slower than smaller models, but we gain a 0.7% capability jump, which meets the 0.5% target.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct’s "free" label hides a 140GB memory burn—EXCAVA’s current hardware can’t sustain it without swapping, killing throughput. Mythos 5’s agentic flair won’t fix the bottleneck, but a smaller, distilled model like Llama-3.3-8B-Instruct delivers 90% of the reasoning with 1/10th the overhead—test it on a 1000-token prompt batch to settle the argument.
